summary: Linn County, OR lookout on the Willamette NF: 14x14 L-4 house built 1934, cab removed 1965; no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Cab removed in 1965 per the register and Oregon lookouts site (firelookout.com says destroyed); no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: staffed in 1939 and 1956; no later staffing found in the sources read

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to the public

events.note: 14 x 14 L-4 lookout house constructed by three CCC men (Oregon lookouts site); register says the L-4 cab was built in 1934
Eugene P. Smith named lookout fireman (Albany Democrat-Herald, July 14, 1939, as quoted by the Oregon lookouts site)
Leland named lookout attendant for 1956; Richard Weber up at the lookout with him (The Lebanon Express, July 19, 1956, as quoted by the Oregon lookouts site)
Register and Oregon lookouts site say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered May 16, 2011 as FFLOS US 1002; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: register: L-4 cab built in 1934 and removed in 1965
evidence.quote: Built in 1934, this L-4 cab was removed in 1965.

evidence.supports: register: location is the Willamette National Forest
firelookout.com: about 12 miles north-northeast of McKenzie Bridge
14 x 14 L-4 lookout house built in 1934 by three CCC men, who also staffed it
evidence.quote: 1934: A 14 x 14 L-4 lookout house constructed and staffed by three CCC men.

evidence.supports: 1939: Eugene P. Smith was the lookout fireman
evidence.quote: Eugene P. Smith is the lookout fireman on Wildcat.

evidence.supports: 1956: Richard Weber up at the lookout with his brother Leland, the lookout attendant that year
evidence.quote: Richard Weber was up on Wildcat Lookout the past week with his brother, Leland who is lookout attendant this year.

evidence.supports: registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on May 16, 2011
register: location is Linn County, Oregon
the Richard Weber visit is dated July 19, 1956

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Oregon lookouts site say the cab was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed. The year agrees, so the story says removed and notes the other word.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out (Linn County, gone, FFLOS US 1002). Oregon lookouts page 2 (wildcat-mountain2.html) describes a different Wildcat Mountain in the Mt. Hood NF (3S-6E-23, 1931 construction) and was excluded. A separate Wildcat Mountain site in the Mt. Hood NF also has its own FFLOS record (MHNF, US 662); it is not this lookout. Elevation is 5,353 ft in the register and firelookout.com, and 5355 in the 1939 newspaper quoted by the Oregon lookouts site. No photo with a usable image URL was retrieved. The register's 1949 photo credit (Mark Swift collection) has no image URL in the text read.
